meta.name: ui-ux-pro-max
meta.description: UI/UX design intelligence for web and mobile. Searchable local database with 84 styles, 192 color palettes, 74 font pairings, 192 product types, 98 UX guidelines, 104 icon entries, 16 GSAP motion presets, and 25 chart types across 22 stacks (React, Next.js, Vue, Nuxt, Svelte, Astro, SwiftUI, React Native, Flutter, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Jetpack Compose, Angular, Laravel, JavaFX, WPF, WinUI, Avalonia, Uno Platform, UWP, Three.js, and HTML/CSS). Use when designing, building, or reviewing UI: pages, components, color schemes, typography, layout, accessibility, animation, or data visualization.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 随时查阅界面风格、配色、字体与动效规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在设计网页或应用界面，想快速找到合适的风格与规范。
copy.tagline_en: Look up UI styles, palettes, fonts, and motion presets on demand.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build websites or apps and need quick design guidance.

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 做界面设计时会查询本地设计规则库,按 10 级优先级给出配色、字体、布局等建议;还能生成并保存整套设计系统文档(含主文件与页面覆盖)。
howto.when: 当任务是设计、搭建或审查网页/移动端界面(如页面、配色、排版等)时触发;纯后端逻辑、API、运维等非界面工作一般不触发。

say.text: 请给美容 SPA 网站生成设计系统,含配色、字体和风格。
say.note: 技能会并行查样式、配色、排版等库,给出成套建议。

say.text: 请帮这个 Next.js 后台仪表盘推荐配色、图表和动效预设。
say.note: 按检测到的技术栈返回对应指导与动效预设。

say.text: 请按可访问性规则审查这个登录页,列出要改的点。
say.note: 优先跑对比度、键盘导航、焦点状态等检查。

howto.what_en: Claude consults a local UI/UX design database for interface work. It gives priority-ranked advice on colors, fonts, layout, etc., and can generate/save a design system (master + page overrides).
howto.when_en: Triggered when designing, building, or reviewing UI (pages, colors, typography, etc.). Generally not for pure backend, API/database, or DevOps work.

say_en.text: Generate a design system for a beauty spa site: colors, typography, style.
say_en.note: Queries style, color, and typography rules in parallel.

say_en.text: Recommend colors, charts, and motion presets for this Next.js dashboard.
say_en.note: Uses detected stack; queries chart, color, and GSAP rules.

say_en.text: Audit this landing page for accessibility: contrast, keyboard nav, focus.
